# statusdrift_on_call_schedule (Data Source)

Fetches a single on-call schedule by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_on_call_schedule" "primary" {
  name = "Primary On-Call"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the on-call schedule.
- `name` (String) The name of the on-call schedule.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is active.
- `frequency` (String) Rotation frequency.
- `participant_ids` (List of Number) Ordered list of organization member IDs in the rotation.
- `rotation_interval` (Number) Rotation interval.
- `starts_at` (String) Schedule start time.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone.
